messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Verdant Systems (acct: enterprise-verdant) embeddings pipeline (eu-west-1) returning 5xxs — paging oncall::sre
elena: ack. I'm taking this. Seeing elevated 5xxs from embed-service: kv-cache miss spike. Reproducing locally.
sam: oncall-sre here, jumping in — can you paste logs? any deploys?
elena: quick logs:
```
embed-service | ERROR  2026-03-17T12:04:02Z  upstream 502 unmarshal failed
prefix-cache-miss: 1.9s
```
no recent deploys in eu-west-1 for embeds (checked deploy-bot).
mike: tagging account-ops — Verdant uses dedicated capacity in eu-west-1. Customer impact: search & suggestions degraded for 1.2k users; support ticket queue has 3 incoming from Verdant.
jordan: support here — draft customer line: "We're investigating an issue impacting search-relevance and recommendations for Verdant Systems in eu-west-1. Our SRE team is actively mitigating." Thoughts?
sam: add ETA to first update: "we expect update within 30 mins." Also include their paid-dedicated SLA note.
statusbot: STATUS PAGE DRAFT (internal): "Degradation for enterprise-verdant in eu-west-1 affecting embeddings/scoring. Root cause under investigation. Impact: Some API calls returning 502/503. Next update: 30 minutes."
elena: I can roll back last quantization patch on nodes serving embeds; planning immediate rollback on 3 shards. Doing canary rollback now.
incident-bot: rollback job started by elena — job id job-73812; progress: canary 1/3 succeeded.
mike: please prepare account contact list for outreach: primary: claire@verdant.com (PM), backup: ops@verdant.com, CSM: rachel@redwood-csm. Also note phone on-call: +1-555-0103.
jordan: customer notification draft v1:
"Hi Claire — We're investigating degraded recommendations/search in eu-west-1. Our SREs are performing a rollback to restore service. We'll update in ~30 minutes. If you see production-impact, reply or call +1-555-0103."
sam: looks good. add severity and note "no data loss".
elena: canary 2/3 succeeded, rolling to remainder.
statusbot: STATUS PAGE UPDATE: "Mitigation in progress: rollback to previous model/quantization profile underway. Customer impact: intermittent 5xxs for embedding endpoints. Next update: 15 minutes or on change."
incident-bot: paging next oncall (night): @luis — handoff scheduled in 20 mins. elena, please include runbook link.
elena: adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeds-fallback. Also noting play: disable prefix caching on affected shards if rollback doesn't pass.
mike: sending tailored customer note now, will CC CSM. I'll post copy to support ticket.
jordan: posted to support ticket #123456. Customer replied: "Thanks — watching, please escalate." Claire added phone number.
sam: rolling patch complete, 100% shards healthy, error rates back to baseline.
statusbot: FINAL STATUS PAGE: "Resolved: Rollback completed restoring embedding endpoints for enterprise-verdant in eu-west-1. Errors returned to baseline at 12:28 UTC. Root cause: quantization patch introduced in recent rollout causing unmarshal errors on older GPU kernels. Remediation: rollback + reverting patch. Customer impact: transient degradation, no data loss. Follow-up: regression test and canary gating adjustments."
mike: I've sent tailored closure email to Claire and the ops team. Copy: "Service restored at 12:28 UTC. We're conducting a post-incident review and will share findings." will attach timeline.
sam: closing incident, handoff to luis for postmortem in morning. :white_check_mark:
